title: Recommendations on film theory for methodological analysis / Question on Kracauer's theory

commenti.body:
I have no personal inputs, but I'm going to set you two up because I was scrolling the sub and your posts/comment aligned: 

u/engfenrno

"If anyone is interested in a critical look at the film It's A Wonderful Life there's a new 10 part podcast on iHeart called George Bailey Was Never Born that examines it's cultural significance. It covers everything from examining if Mary Hatch was the real hero to the idea that everywhere in the US has become Pottersville to why Ayn Rand felt the film was a threat to the the capitalist system and had the FBI investigate it. https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-george-bailey-was-never-b-127106279/"
